name: claude-compaction
description: The turn KAR-09.6 is about: a little work, the vendor's own auto-compaction (the live status frame followed by the compact_boundary frame carrying pre_tokens and nothing else), more work, and a result envelope whose modelUsage reports the input tokens of the turn after the compaction. The pre_tokens and inputTokens figures match test/fixtures/streams/compact-boundary.stream-json.jsonl, so the parser specs and the process specs are asserting the same numbers.
